headline: Your morning brief now reads the same trust-gated project memory as everything else, past records can be filed to their project with one tap, and decisions that were carried out finally leave the active list.

items.prompt_template: Three things you will notice. (1) The morning brief's per-project lines draw on the same canonical, trust-gated read of each project's history that preps, project loads and drafts already use — steadier one-liners, nothing to do. (2) Say 'review project bindings' when you have a minute: it shows past notes and captures that name a project they were never filed under, one tap each — Bind or Not this project — with a single undo for the batch. Nothing is filed automatically. (3) Decisions your record shows were carried out now sit in a Resolved bucket instead of lingering as active; nothing is deleted and the history stays. Also: the cards in your people directory no longer show an internal id next to each name.
